:Against: = AGAINST / NAY

I need to be honest, I'm not sure how I feel about this one. It's certainly well thought and well written. My first impulse was that "countries should be able to ban this" and this resolution disallows that. But I don't want to be "ahhhh new technology bad, burn the witch." 

I wish I had been paying attention to the WA when this was being drafted because I actually have questions for once, but alas, that's my own fault, I suppose. What does "the WA Commission on Human Rights shall ensure member state laws are sufficient" mean? What power does that actually grant the Commission? 

I... am skeptical. I'm voting ❌ for now, but I could be convinced.

Update: I posted some questions in the discussion thread and the authors have decided to write a new draft that will replace the one currently in queue. https://forum.nationstates.net/viewtopic.php?p=42497178#p42497178

😅 I got so many notifications as the other two were discussing. 
Thanks for the feedback again! 
We plan to keep it open for a week or two to allow for more comments before we go to submit it again.
You're very welcome! I hope everything goes smoothly for you from here on out 🙏
